#### 1. **Core Innovation**  
The paper introduces **Class-Aware PillarMix**, an advanced mixed sample data augmentation (MSDA) method designed to enhance 3D object detection using radar point clouds. This approach addresses the challenge of limited labeled data in 3D perception tasks by leveraging unlabeled or underrepresented data.
